assignments.name: sender_id
assignments.value: ={{ $json.body.message?.from?.id != null ? String($json.body.message.from.id) : ($json.body.edited_message?.from?.id != null ? String($json.body.edited_message.from.id) : ($json.body.callback_query?.from?.id != null ? String($json.body.callback_query.from.id) : "")) }}

assignments.name: secret_valid
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const t = String($json.headers['x-telegram-bot-api-secret-token'] || $json.headers['X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token'] || '').trim(); const e = String($env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET || '').trim(); return t !== '' && e !== '' && t === e; })() }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ({
  source: 'telegram',
  chat_id: $json.chat_id,
  sender_id: $json.sender_id,
  text: $json.normalized_text || $json.text,
  metadata: {
    telegram_update_id: $json.update_id,
    telegram_message_id: $json.message_id,
    telegram_username: $json.username,
    reply_to_message_id: $json.reply_to_message_id ?? null,\n    reply_to_text: $json.reply_to_text || null,
    original_text: $json.original_text || $json.text,
    memory_kind: $json.memory_kind || 'idea',
    memory_topic: $json.memory_topic || 'общий контекст',
    obsidian_branch: $json.obsidian_branch || null,
    obsidian_note_path: $json.obsidian_note_path || null,
    is_command: Boolean($json.command_detected || false),
    command_mode: $json.command_mode || null,
    command_prompt: $json.command_prompt || null,
    command_provider: $json.command_provider || null,
    command_model: $json.command_model || null,
    command_history_count: $json.command_history_count ?? null,
    command_context_depth: $json.command_context_depth ?? null,
    assistant_answer: $json.ai_answer || null,
    embedding_provider: $json.embedding_provider,
    embedding_key_slot: $json.embedding_key_slot,
    embedding_total_keys: $json.embedding_total_keys
  },
  embedding: $json.vector_literal
}) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const iso = new Date().toISOString();
const title = String($json.memory_topic || 'general').replace(/\s*\/\s*/g, ' - ').trim();

const content = [
  '---',
  `created: ${iso}`,
  'source: telegram',
  `kind: ${$json.memory_kind || 'idea'}`,
  `chat_id: ${$json.chat_id || ''}`,
  `message_id: ${$json.message_id || ''}`,
  `update_id: ${$json.update_id || ''}`,
  'tags: [telegram, assistant, auto]',
  '---',
  '',
  `# ${title || 'Telegram Note'}`,
  '',
  String($json.normalized_text || $json.text || '').trim(),
  '',
  '## Metadata',
  `- branch: ${$json.obsidian_branch || 'Inbox/Ideas'}`,
  `- path: ${$json.obsidian_note_path || ''}`,
  `- command_mode: ${$json.command_mode || 'none'}`,
  `- provider: ${$json.command_provider || 'none'}`,
  `- model: ${$json.command_model || 'none'}`,
  '',
  String($json.ai_answer || '').trim() ? '## Assistant Response\n' + String($json.ai_answer || '').trim() : '',
].filter(Boolean).join('\n');

return [{
  ...$json,
  obsidian_sync_enabled: true,
  obsidian_sync_webhook: String($env.OBSIDIAN_SYNC_WEBHOOK_URL || 'http://autoro-obsidian-relay:8787/sync').trim(),
  obsidian_sync_payload: {
    file_path: String($json.obsidian_note_path || '').trim(),
    branch: String($json.obsidian_branch || 'Inbox/Ideas').trim(),
    mode: 'append_or_create',
    content,
    metadata: {
      kind: $json.memory_kind || 'idea',
      topic: $json.memory_topic || 'общий контекст',
      chat_id: $json.chat_id || '',
      message_id: $json.message_id || null,
      update_id: $json.update_id || null,
      command_mode: $json.command_mode || null,
    },
  },
}];
